```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

library(DESeq2)
library(Glimma)
library(rtracklayer)
library(GeneOrthology)
```

```{r}
build_tx2gene <- function(gtf_file_path){
  tx2gene <- rtracklayer::readGFF(gtf_file_path) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name) |>
    distinct() |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(transcript_id))
}

prepare_samples <- function(sample_sheet_path){
  sample_sheet <- read.csv(sample_sheet_path) |>
    mutate(time_fct = factor(timepoint_days),
           time_num = as.numeric(timepoint_days),
           subject = factor(subject))
}

import_kallisto <- function(kallisto_path){
  files <- file.path(list.dirs(kallisto_path)[-1], "abundance.h5")
  names(files) <- gsub(paste0(kallisto_path, "/"), "", list.dirs(kallisto_path)[-1])
  txi <- tximport(files, type = "kallisto",
                tx2gene = tx2gene,
                txOut = FALSE,
                ignoreTxVersion = TRUE)
}


run_model <- function(txi=txi,
                      sample_sheet=sample_sheet,
                      design,
                      reduced,
                      test = "Wald",
                      col) {
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi,
                                  colData = sample_sheet,
                                  design = design)
  if (test == "LRT") {
    dds <- DESeq(dds, test = test, reduced = reduced)
  }
  else {
    dds <- DESeq(dds, test = test)
  }
  return(dds)
}
  
process_results <- function(dds=dds, tx2gene=tx2gene, alpha = 0.05){
  res <- results(dds)
  print(summary(res))
  res <- res |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    left_join(tx2gene, by = "gene_id") |>
    select(-transcript_id) |>
    distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    filter(!is.na(padj)) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    filter(padj < alpha)
    return(res)
}
```

```{r}
wd = "D:/canine-seq"
setwd(wd)

sample_sheet_path = "D:/canine-seq/data/ORBIT/sample_sheet.csv"
gtf_path = "D:/canine-seq/reference/dog/canfam4/Canis_lupus_familiarisgsd.UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0.116.gtf.gz"
kallisto_path = "D:/canine-seq/results/ORBIT/kallisto"

sample_sheet <- prepare_samples(sample_sheet_path)
tx2gene <- build_tx2gene(gtf_path)
txi <- import_kallisto(kallisto_path)

counts <- as.data.frame(txi$counts)
```

```{r}
# examples for one sample
summary(raw_counts[,1])
#hist(log2(raw_counts[,1] + 1))
sum(raw_counts[,1] > 0) #number of expressed genes

head(data.frame(gene = rownames(raw_counts)[top_idx],
                count = raw_counts[[1]][top_idx]),20)
ggplot(raw_counts) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(x=raw_counts[[1]]), stat = "bin", bins = 200) + 
  xlab("Raw counts") + 
  ylab("Number of genes")

ggplot(raw_counts) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = log2(raw_counts[,1] + 1)),bins = 100) +
  xlab("log2(count + 1)") +
  ylab("Number of genes")
```


```{r}
# SUBJECT ONLY MODEL
# shows differences in expression between subjects regardless of time
dds_subject <- run_model(txi,
                        sample_sheet,
                        design = ~ subject,
                        test = "Wald",
                        col = time_fct)
glimmaMA(dds_subject, groups = colData(dds_subject)$time_fct)
subject_df <- process_results(dds_subject, tx2gene, 0.05)
```

```{r}
# TIME + SUBJECT LRT W/ TIME AS NUMERIC # linear effects over time
# shows the genes that are differentially expressed over time accounting for variation between subjects
dds_st_num <- run_model(txi,
                        sample_sheet,
                        design = ~ subject + time_num,
                        reduced = ~ subject,
                        test = "LRT",
                        col = time_num)
glimmaMA(dds_st_num, groups = colData(dds_st_num)$time_num)
res_st_num_df <- process_results(dds_st_fct, tx2gene, 0.05)
```


```{r}
# TIME + SUBJECT LRT W/ TIME AS FACTOR # non linear effects over time
# shows the genes that are differentially expressed over time accounting for variation between subjects
dds_st_fct <- run_model(txi,
                        sample_sheet,
                        design = ~ subject + time_fct,
                        reduced = ~ subject,
                        test = "LRT",
                        col = time_fct)
glimmaMA(dds_st_fct, groups = colData(dds_st_fct)$time_fct)
res_st_fct_df <- process_results(dds_st_fct, tx2gene, 0.05)
```
